+def search_users(query: str) -> list[dict]:
+    # In-memory search
+    from app.db.store import _USERS
+    query = query.lower()
+    results = [
+        user for user in _USERS.values()
+        if query in user["name"].lower() or query in user["email"].lower()
+    ]
+    return sorted(results, key=lambda u: u["id"])
